slots.description: Storage position (for example A1-L1-S1-D1) to container id.

ports.description: Port id to container id; an empty string means the port is empty.

404.description: The robot or AS/RS is unknown (robot-not-found, asrs-not-found).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.

code.description: The stable problem slug (for example port-occupied); its replay class is listed in ADR 0006.

schema.title: Problem
